result.instructions: Tools for Notifyre, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many texts did we send this week, and were they delivered?"; "Show the replies we received to our texts today."; "Which faxes did we receive this week, and from which numbers?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Notifyre data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run notifyre_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run notifyre_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run notifyre_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. notifyre_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: notifyre_list_sent_sms
tools.title: List sent SMS
tools.description: List SMS messages sent from the account, newest first by default, with recipient, status and cost. Without from_date the window is the last 30 days. Filter by status (processing, submitted, sent, failed), numbers, or a message id in search. Page with skip = next_skip. Notifyre API: GET /sms/send.

from_date.description: Start, ISO 8601 date (2026-10-01) or date-time with timezone. Default: 30 days before to_date.

to_date.description: End, ISO 8601 date (2026-10-31, to the end of that UTC day) or date-time. Default: now.

to_number.description: Destination number the SMS was sent to.

from_number.description: Number the SMS was sent from.

search.description: Filter by message id or scheduled job id.

sort.description: asc or desc by date (default desc).

tools.name: notifyre_get_sent_sms
tools.title: Get a sent SMS
tools.description: Get one sent SMS message with every recipient: status, delivery status, message parts, cost. Use the id from notifyre_list_sent_sms or notifyre_send_sms. Notifyre API: GET /sms/send/{id}.

message_id.description: The SMS message id (not the friendly id).

tools.name: notifyre_get_sms_recipient
tools.title: Get an SMS recipient message
tools.description: Get the text and delivery details of one recipient of a sent SMS (status, parts, cost). Notifyre API: GET /sms/send/{messageId}/recipients/{recipientId}.

tools.name: notifyre_list_sms_replies
tools.title: List SMS replies
tools.description: List SMS replies received on the account's numbers. Without from_date the window is the last 30 days. from_number and to_number must be given together. include_reply_content adds the reply texts (then at most 20 per page). Page with skip = next_skip. Notifyre API: GET /sms/received.

from_date.description: Start, ISO 8601 date or date-time with timezone. Default: 30 days before to_date.

to_date.description: End, ISO 8601 date or date-time. Default: now.

from_number.description: Number the reply came from. Needs to_number as well.

to_number.description: Account number that received the reply. Needs from_number as well.

recipient_id.description: Only replies to this SMS recipient id.

include_reply_content.description: Include the reply texts (default false; limit is then capped at 20).

sort.description: asc or desc by date (default desc).

tools.name: notifyre_get_sms_reply
tools.title: Get an SMS reply
tools.description: Get one received SMS reply with its text, sender and receiving number. Use the replyID from notifyre_list_sms_replies. Notifyre API: GET /sms/received/{id}.

tools.name: notifyre_list_sms_numbers
tools.title: List SMS numbers and sender IDs
tools.description: List the account's SMS numbers (E.164, status, 10DLC campaign) and approved alphanumeric sender IDs. Use one of them as `from` when sending. Notifyre API: GET /sms/numbers.

annotations.title: List SMS numbers and sender IDs

tools.name: notifyre_list_sms_prices
tools.title: List SMS prices
tools.description: List the price of one SMS per destination country (country code, calling prefix, price, currency). Check it before sending: the cost of a send is price x message parts x recipients. Notifyre API: GET /sms/send/prices.

tools.name: notifyre_list_sent_faxes
tools.title: List sent faxes
tools.description: List faxes sent from the account (recipient, pages, quality, status, failure reason). Without from_date the window is the last 30 days. Filter by status (accepted, successful, in_progress, failed, queued). Page with skip = next_skip. Notifyre API: GET /fax/send.

from_date.description: Start, ISO 8601 date or date-time with timezone. Default: 30 days before to_date.

to_date.description: End, ISO 8601 date or date-time. Default: now.

search.description: Filter by fax id or reference.

sort.description: asc or desc by date (default desc).

tools.name: notifyre_list_received_faxes
tools.title: List received faxes
tools.description: List faxes received on the account's fax numbers (sender, number, time, pages, duration, read flag). The fax documents are not downloaded. Without from_date the window is the last 30 days. Page with skip = next_skip. Notifyre API: GET /fax/received.

from_date.description: Start, ISO 8601 date or date-time with timezone. Default: 30 days before to_date.

to_date.description: End, ISO 8601 date or date-time. Default: now.

to_number.description: Only faxes received on this account fax number.

sort.description: asc or desc by date (default desc).

tools.name: notifyre_list_fax_numbers
tools.title: List fax numbers
tools.description: List the account's fax numbers (E.164, region, status). Notifyre API: GET /fax/numbers.

tools.name: notifyre_list_fax_prices
tools.title: List fax prices
tools.description: List the price of sending a fax per destination country (country code, calling prefix, price, currency). Notifyre API: GET /fax/send/prices.

tools.name: notifyre_list_fax_cover_pages
tools.title: List fax cover pages
tools.description: List the fax cover page templates of the account (name and whether it is the default). The HTML of each template is left out. Notifyre API: GET /fax/coverpages.

tools.name: notifyre_list_contacts
tools.title: List address book contacts
tools.description: Search the address book. search_query matches the name; type FaxNumber or MobileNumber keeps contacts that have that number; group_ids limits to groups. Page numbers start at 0. Contacts that unsubscribed are left out unless include_unsubscribed is true. The unsubscribe key of a contact is never shown. Notifyre API: POST /addressbook/contacts/search (a read).

type.description: Only contacts that have this kind of number.

group_ids.description: Only contacts in these group ids.

include_unsubscribed.description: Also return contacts that unsubscribed (default false).

tools.name: notifyre_get_contact
tools.title: Get an address book contact
tools.description: Get one contact: names, organization, email, fax and mobile number, groups, custom fields, unsubscribed flag. Notifyre API: GET /addressbook/contacts/{id}.

tools.name: notifyre_list_groups
tools.title: List address book groups
tools.description: List the address book groups with their contact counts. Notifyre API: GET /addressbook/groups.

tools.name: notifyre_list_brands
tools.title: List 10DLC brands
tools.description: List the account's registered 10DLC brands (US SMS sender registration). Notifyre API: GET /numbers/brands.

tools.name: notifyre_list_campaigns
tools.title: List 10DLC campaigns
tools.description: List the account's 10DLC campaigns (US SMS use-case registrations) and their status. Notifyre API: GET /numbers/campaigns.

tools.name: notifyre_send_sms
tools.title: Send SMS
tools.description: WRITE: SENDS REAL SMS to real people and SPENDS the prepaid balance of the user's Notifyre account; it cannot be undone or recalled and is never retried. One text to 1 to 10 mobile numbers in international format with "+" (e.g. +61412345678); no contacts, no groups, no scheduling. Cost = price per message part (see notifyre_list_sms_prices; it depends on the destination country) x number of parts x number of recipients; the text may be up to 640 characters (160 per part, 70 with emoji or non-GSM characters, a little less per part when it is longer). Only send what the user explicitly asked for: confirm the exact text, the recipients and the sender first. Recipients must have agreed to receive messages. A commercial SMS needs an opt-out (Australia: Spam Act 2003; Notifyre Terms and Conditions 13.5): set add_unsubscribe_link true to append Notifyre's opt-out link, or put your own opt-out instruction in the text. The default is false, so the requirement is yours to meet. US numbers need a registered 10DLC campaign. Omit `from` to send from a Notifyre shared number. An unclear result (timeout, HTTP 5xx) means the message may still have been sent: check notifyre_list_sent_sms before trying again. Notifyre API: POST /sms/send.

to.description: 1 to 10 mobile numbers in international format with country code and "+", e.g. +61412345678.

from.description: Optional sender: one of the account's SMS numbers or sender IDs (see notifyre_list_sms_numbers). Omit to use a Notifyre shared number.

add_unsubscribe_link.description: Append Notifyre's opt-out link to the text (default false). A commercial SMS needs an opt-out: set true, or write your own opt-out line. Adds characters, so it can add a part.

campaign_name.description: Optional reference name for this send.

tools.name: notifyre_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: WRITE: adds one contact to the Notifyre address book. Give at least a name or a number. Numbers in international format (e.g. +61412345678). groups takes existing group ids; group_name puts the contact in that group and CREATES the group if it does not exist. Creating the same contact twice may make a duplicate. Notifyre API: POST /addressbook/contacts.

group_ids.description: Existing group ids to add the contact to.

group_name.description: Group name to add the contact to (created if missing).

tools.name: notifyre_create_group
tools.title: Create a contact group
tools.description: WRITE: creates one address book group with the given name. Notifyre API: POST /addressbook/groups.

tools.name: notifyre_add_contacts_to_groups
tools.title: Add contacts to groups
tools.description: WRITE: adds existing contacts to existing groups (up to 100 contacts and 20 groups). Contacts keep their other groups. Adding a contact to a group does not send anything, but a later send to that group reaches it. Notifyre API: POST /addressbook/groups/contacts.
